plainText:
Pokémon Adventures RGB volume 1 (Japanese: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL pbk-edition 赤緑青編 1 Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter volume 1) is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: A Glimpse of the Glow
Chapter 2: Bulbasaur, Come Home!
Chapter 3: The Secret of Kangaskhan
Chapter 4: Wanted: Pikachu!
Chapter 5: Onix Is On!
Chapter 6: Gyarados Splashes In!
Chapter 7: Raging Rhydon
Chapter 8: Suddenly Starmie
Chapter 9: ...But Fearow Itself!
Chapter 10: Danger: High Voltorb
Chapter 11: Buzz Off, Electabuzz!
Chapter 12: Wake Up—You're Snorlax!
Chapter 13: Sigh for Psyduck
Chapter 14: That Awful Arbok!
Chapter 15 - Wartortle Wars
Chapter 16 - Tauros the Tyrant
Chapter 17 - The Jynx Jinx
Chapter 18 - A Tale of Ninetales
Chapter 19 - Blame It on Eevee
Chapter 20 - Meanwhile...Vileplume!
Chapter 21 - Long Live the Nidoking!
Chapter 22 - A Hollow Victreebel

==Major events==

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Blue's evolves into sometime between PS003 and PS005.
Red's evolves into in PS011.
Red's ("Saur") evolves into in PS015.
Blue's evolves into in PS018.

==Gym battles==
Red defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Brock in PS005
Koga in PS007 (unknowingly, no Badge gained)
Misty in PS008
Lt. Surge in PS011 (does not get a Badge)
Erika in PS020
